description: Inspect a Minecraft box-UV entity layout, write a template PNG and/or an editable .mcpx with one named region per face (optionally face-colored), validate a texture's size and report non-transparent pixels outside every face, or render four isometric views of the texture wrapped around the layout's parts. Builtin player wide/slim layouts plus caller-supplied layout documents; reads only except template and preview outputs.

fill.description: template: fill each face with its face color; default true. false leaves the face areas transparent.

inputPath.description: validate or preview: texture raster path (PNG, JPEG, WebP).

layout.description: Builtin layout id (player_wide/steve, player_slim/alex), a layout .json path, or an inline layout document. Defaults to player_wide.

mode.description: inspect is read-only; template writes a per-face PNG and/or .mcpx; validate checks a texture against a layout; preview renders four isometric views of the texture wrapped around the layout's parts.

outputMcpxPath.description: template: explicit .mcpx path. When omitted, the source text is returned in the report.

outputPngPath.description: template or preview: explicit .png path. When omitted, the image is returned as a standard image block.

size.description: preview: panel edge size, one of 64, 128, or 256; default 128. The image is 4 panels wide plus a label strip.

name: entity_asset
